faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Click a question to show the answer.
faq.aAts: ATS stands for Applicant Tracking System. It is software many companies use to collect applications, store resumes, and often run an automatic first screening using keywords and job criteria. A resume aligned with the posting text is more likely to pass that stage and be reviewed by a person.
faq.qFirstFree: Is the first adaptation really free?
faq.aFirstFree: Yes. You can complete your first adaptation without buying credits. For additional submissions, you need credits linked to the same email you used at purchase.
faq.aCredits: Each credit lets you adapt one resume. You pick a package with the number you need; credits do not expire. When you submit the form, use the email from your purchase so the system can apply your credits.
faq.qNoCredits: What happens if I submit a resume when I have no credits left?
faq.aNoCredits: In every email reply we include how many credits you currently have. If you send a new request and there are not enough credits, we say so clearly in that message. That is fine: as soon as you buy more credits and have balance available, we continue and send your adapted resume.
faq.qFormats: Which file formats do you accept?
faq.aFormats: We accept PDF or DOCX files up to 5 MB.
faq.qJobDesc: What do I need to send besides my resume?
faq.aJobDesc: The job description (posting text, requirements, responsibilities, tech stack or benefits when relevant). The closer it is to what the company published, the more accurate the adaptation.
faq.qDelivery: How long until I receive my adapted resume?
faq.aDelivery: You usually receive the result by email within a few minutes after submitting. Exact timing can vary depending on queue and processing.
faq.aData: We handle your resume and job description carefully. As stated on the site, your data is not shared with third parties. For legal details, see our Privacy Policy.
faq.aPayment: Credit purchases are processed by Mercado Pago, with options such as PIX, card, and boleto when available for your account.
faq.qSupport: Is there a way to contact you or get customer support?
faq.aSupport: Yes. For questions, issues, help, or anything else, email us at support@adaptcv.app — we will get back to you as soon as we can.

privacyContent.intro: This Policy explains how AdaptCV collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018 — LGPD).
privacyContent.s1p1: **AdaptCV** is an online platform that uses artificial intelligence to tailor résumés to specific job postings. We operate at adaptcv.app.
privacyContent.s1p2: For LGPD purposes, AdaptCV acts as **controller** of personal data processed through this platform.
privacyContent.s2Intro: We only collect data that is strictly necessary to provide the service:
privacyContent.s2li0: **Identification data:** email address provided when you use the service.
privacyContent.s2li1: **Résumé (CV):** the document you submit for adaptation. It may include name, work history, education, contact details, and other personal information.
privacyContent.s2li2: **Job description:** text or file you provide to contextualize the adaptation.
privacyContent.s2li3: **Payment data:** processed entirely by Mercado Pago. We do not store credit card or banking credentials.
privacyContent.s2li4: **Usage data:** access logs, IP address, and browser technical data collected automatically for security and performance.
privacyContent.s3Intro: Your data is used solely for the following purposes:
privacyContent.s3li0: Processing your résumé with AI and generating the adapted version;
privacyContent.s3li1: Sending the adapted résumé to the email you provide;
privacyContent.s3li2: Managing your credit balance and processing payments;
privacyContent.s3li5: Complying with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacyContent.s3Highlight: **Important:** we do not use your résumé to train AI models, we do not share your data with advertisers, and we do not sell your information to third parties.
privacyContent.s4Intro: We process your data on the following LGPD bases:
privacyContent.s4li0: **Performance of a contract** (Art. 7, V): to process your CV and deliver the contracted service.
privacyContent.s4li1: **Legitimate interest** (Art. 7, IX): to ensure security, prevent fraud, and improve the platform.
privacyContent.s4li2: **Compliance with a legal obligation** (Art. 7, II): when required by law or competent authority.
privacyContent.s4li3: **Consent** (Art. 7, I): for marketing communications, when applicable; and for Google Analytics measurement cookies when you accept the cookie banner on the site.
privacyContent.s5p1: Your data may be shared only with partners essential to providing the service, always under contract and confidentiality obligations:
privacyContent.s5li0: **AI providers** (e.g. Anthropic): to process résumé content. Data is transmitted securely and is not retained by the provider for training purposes.
privacyContent.s5li2: **Transactional email provider:** to send the adapted résumé to your email.
privacyContent.s5li4: **Google (Analytics):** only if you consent to measurement cookies in the site banner — for aggregated usage statistics.
privacyContent.s5p2: We do not transfer data for commercial or advertising purposes.
privacyContent.s6Intro: We retain data for the following periods:
privacyContent.s6li0: **Résumé and job description:** deleted within **30 days** after processing.
privacyContent.s6li1: **Email and usage history:** kept while your account is active or as long as needed to meet legal obligations.
privacyContent.s6li2: **Access logs:** kept for up to 6 months, in line with Brazil’s Marco Civil da Internet (Law 12.965/2014).
privacyContent.s6p2: After the retention period, data is securely deleted or anonymized.
privacyContent.s7Intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacyContent.s7li0: **Confirmation and access:** know whether we process your data and access it.
privacyContent.s7li1: **Correction:** request correction of incomplete or outdated data.
privacyContent.s7li2: **Anonymization, blocking, or deletion:** of unnecessary data or data processed in breach of the LGPD.
privacyContent.s7li3: **Portability:** receive your data in a structured format.
privacyContent.s7li4: **Deletion:** request deletion of data processed on the basis of your consent.
privacyContent.s7li5: **Withdrawal of consent:** at any time, without affecting prior lawful processing.
privacyContent.s7li6: **Objection:** object to processing based on another legal ground.
privacyContent.s7HighlightBefore: To exercise any of these rights, send a request to
privacyContent.s8p1: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, or improper disclosure, including:
privacyContent.s8p2: In the event of a security incident that may affect your rights, we will notify the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) and affected data subjects within legal deadlines.
privacyContent.s9p1: We use a **language preference cookie** to remember your chosen language. If you **accept** the cookie banner, we also use **Google Analytics cookies** to understand aggregated platform usage. If you decline, Google Analytics is not loaded; the rest of the site remains available.
privacyContent.s10p1: We may update this Policy periodically. For material changes, we will notify you by email or platform notice at least 15 days in advance. The effective date is always shown at the top of this document.
privacyContent.s11Intro: For questions, requests, or complaints about personal data processing:
